title: Full Stack TypeScript / Next.js Engineer
description:
Seeking an agile Full Stack Engineer to build fast, responsive enterprise SaaS applications. You will create modern user interfaces using Next.js/React and scale backend APIs in Node.js/TypeScript with PostgreSQL and Redis caching.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience across React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.
- Deep understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL/Prisma), REST & GraphQL APIs.
- Expertise in Tailwind CSS and state management.
education_requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Software Development
